name: The Absent Throne

detectability.signature: Gravitometric null readings; absence of expected gravitational influence; objects in free drift with zero net acceleration

proximity: Gradual loss of gravitational reference—artificial gravity systems compensate but instruments drift
Navigation becomes unreliable as stellar gravitational models fail to account for the void
Debris and dust accumulate at the void's boundary in a visible halo
contact: Complete gravitational silence—no measurable gravity from any direction
Inertial dampeners behave erratically without gravitational baseline
Objects placed within the void remain perfectly stationary unless acted upon by thrust
prolonged_exposure: Crew experiences severe spatial disorientation and nausea from zero-gravity reference
Bone density loss accelerates beyond normal zero-g rates by factor of three
Navigation systems require full recalibration upon exiting the void

phenomena: Objects accelerating without thrust at the boundary as gravity reasserts itself
Gravitational lensing absent despite the anomaly's massive extent
Navigation instruments giving contradictory readings within the void
Dust and debris forming a visible shell at the gravity transition zone
hazards: Navigation system failure within the void
Life support compromise from unexpected zero-g effects on fluid systems
Stranded vessels—without thrust, rescue is difficult in true zero gravity
opportunities: Perfect environment for zero-gravity manufacturing requiring absolute stillness
Unique data on gravitational physics—the void shouldn't exist under current models
Natural defensive position—weapons relying on gravitational calculations fail within
known_incidents: The freighter Solemn Vow drifted into the Absent Throne in 2558 with a disabled engine; without gravity to eventually pull it anywhere, the ship remained perfectly stationary for eleven years before salvage teams retrieved it.
A weapons test conducted within the void in 2634 produced unexpected results—guided munitions lost all targeting capability, leading military planners to classify the region as a natural shield zone.
description: The Absent Throne is defined by what isn't there. Spanning 2.3 AU of irregularly shaped space, it is a region where gravity simply ceases to exist. Not reduced, not weakened—absent. Sensors detect nothing: no gravitational pull from the nearest star, no influence from distant galactic mass, nothing. Objects within the Throne experience true gravitational zero, a state that current physics insists is impossible. The void is invisible to the eye, but its boundary is marked by a faint shell of accumulated dust and debris that drifts to the edge and stops.

Entering the Absent Throne is disorienting in a way that ordinary zero-gravity is not. In normal space, there is always a gravitational gradient, however faint, providing a directional reference. Inside the Throne, that reference vanishes entirely. Inertial dampeners lose their baseline, artificial gravity fluctuates, and the human vestibular system rebels. Ships can traverse the void under thrust, but without engines they are utterly becalmed—the Solemn Vow proved that a ship without power will remain exactly where it stops, indefinitely, with nothing to push or pull it anywhere.

The Absent Throne was discovered accidentally in 2547 when a surveyor noticed that her gravitational models produced impossible residuals in this region. Subsequent investigation revealed the void—and deepened the mystery. No known phenomenon can create a region of zero gravity this large. Dark energy fluctuations, exotic matter shells, and extradimensional interference have all been proposed; none fully explains the observations. The Throne has become a pilgrimage site for theoretical physicists, though the discomfort of extended stays limits research durations.

Today the Absent Throne serves multiple unofficial purposes. A zero-gravity manufacturing consortium operates at its core, producing crystalline structures of impossible purity in the perfect stillness. Military strategists have noted its defensive properties—weapons systems that rely on gravitational calculations fail completely inside the void. And somewhere in the Throne's depths, the Solemn Vow still drifts, salvaged of its cargo but left as a permanent marker. Its running lights were replaced with a navigational beacon, blinking steadily in a place where nothing moves unless you make it.
